content.comment_body: I'm new to using the [product_name], and currently working with a [product_name] display. I'm able to send messages to my counters and display their values. I would like to show the state of the inputs and outputs on a page, but when I configure a new message page, it seems that inputs and outputs cannot be selected. Is there a way to do this, or do I need to use an HMI instead?
There are two options you could try: 1) Display I/O status names 2) Use a bar graph

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to display input and output states on a [product_name] display. However, direct selection of these states within a message page is not possible. Another participant suggests alternative visualization methods, such as showing status names or utilizing a bar graph, implying that while the display of some status information is feasible, direct I/O monitoring on this device may be restricted.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to conveniently view and monitor the states of inputs and outputs directly on the [product_name] display via the message page configuration.
